question.prompt: What starting URL should the web tests use for the ORBITAL dashboard?

options.label: Use {{start_url}}
options.detail: Author the later web tests with a {{start_url}} placeholder until a concrete dashboard URL is supplied.

options.label: Provide URL

content.risk_rationale: The behavior is specified, but runnable web tests cannot start without a concrete entry point or an agreed placeholder.

question.prompt: Which authenticated account should the web tests use to reach the dashboard and open the profile popover?

options.label: Use {{username}}/{{password}}
options.detail: Author the later web tests with {{username}} and {{password}} placeholders until test credentials are supplied.

options.label: Provide credentials
options.detail: Supply the dashboard test account credentials or another concrete authenticated access method.

content.risk_rationale: This use-case is behind an authenticated dashboard; without an account or a named placeholder, later tests cannot reach the profile popover reproducibly.

content.text: Clicking the avatar opens the profile popover.

expected_answer.operand: profile popover becomes visible after the avatar is activated

content.text: The profile popover displays the signed-in user's name.

expected_answer.operand: signed-in user's name is visible in the profile popover

content.text: The profile popover displays the signed-in user's role.

expected_answer.operand: signed-in user's role is visible in the profile popover

content.text: The profile popover displays the current workspace label and value.

expected_answer.operand: Workspace label and the current workspace value are visible in the profile popover

content.text: The profile popover displays the current status label and value.

expected_answer.operand: Status label and the current status value are visible in the profile popover

content.text: The profile popover offers exactly these actions in the list: Preferences, Keyboard shortcuts, and Sign out.

expected_answer.operand: action list shows Preferences, Keyboard shortcuts, and Sign out

content.text: Activating Preferences from the profile popover does not navigate away from the current dashboard page.

expected_answer.baseline: current dashboard page before activating Preferences
expected_answer.operand: same dashboard page remains active after Preferences is activated

content.text: Activating Keyboard shortcuts from the profile popover does not navigate away from the current dashboard page.

expected_answer.baseline: current dashboard page before activating Keyboard shortcuts
expected_answer.operand: same dashboard page remains active after Keyboard shortcuts is activated

content.text: Activating Sign out from the profile popover does not navigate away from the current dashboard page.

expected_answer.baseline: current dashboard page before activating Sign out
expected_answer.operand: same dashboard page remains active after Sign out is activated

judgements.rationale: [risk_factors] Applied user-reach because the avatar-triggered profile popover is a common top-level dashboard control, but no money, data-loss, or change-frequency risk was evidenced.
[risk_factors] Applied auth because the popover exposes signed-in identity details, and user-reach because those details are part of a common account surface on the dashboard.
[risk_factors] Applied auth because the role shown is specific to the signed-in user context, and user-reach because the popover is a globally reachable dashboard control.
[risk_factors] Applied auth because workspace context is tied to the signed-in session, and user-reach because the workspace information is shown from the global avatar popover.
[risk_factors] Applied auth because status is shown as part of the signed-in user context, and user-reach because the status appears in a globally reachable profile popover.
[risk_factors] Applied auth because the action list is available only in the signed-in profile surface, and user-reach because those actions are exposed from the global avatar popover.
[risk_factors] Applied auth because Preferences is a profile action for the signed-in user, and user-reach because unexpected navigation would disrupt a common dashboard action path.
[risk_factors] Applied auth because Keyboard shortcuts is a profile action for the signed-in user, and user-reach because unexpected navigation would disrupt a common dashboard action path.
[risk_factors] Applied auth because Sign out is a session-related profile action, and user-reach because the source explicitly required this common action to stay in-page.
